tickets.text: Add: elder-lens opposed. The trigger buys strength at a new high; elder 10.0 [5, 1, 7, 9, 10] is a summer plateau with no fresh permission bar (C20, C4), and D swing LH/LL against W HH/HL is transitional tape where Elder takes nothing (C22). Would clear: a dip-into-ma20 trigger with elder 7 or more, or D swing resolving to HH/HL.

Add: elder-lens opposed. The trigger buys a breakout from a pinned plateau, elder 10.0 [10, 10, 10, 10, 10], with no transition bar (C4, C20); W swing LH/LL leaves the tide unresolved (C21). Only unsourced C24 supports it. Would clear: W swing resolving to HH/HL and a pullback-into-ma20 trigger with elder 7 or more.

Add: elder-lens supports WATCH with a reservation. elder 10.0 [10, 7, 7, 10, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY is the R8 analogue, incomplete (volume half unread). The 'pullback holds the broken pivot' leg is not in the trigger word; reclaim of yesterday's high counts only after the pullback holds.

Add: elder-lens opposed ADVANCE. h1_close_above:bar_high buys strength in front of price, not under the average (C10). elder 10.0 [10, 7, 4, 9, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY: the 4 to 9 permission bar is two sessions old; W swing LH leaves the tide unresolved (C21). Would clear: WATCH, or a pullback into ma20 with elder 7 or more.
